findings.highlight: bumping against the front door
findings.evidenceJa: がちゃん、と背中を玄関で強打する
findings.governingReading: he strikes his back hard against the entrance with a crash
findings.explanation: mirror moon reduces a forceful, noisy impact to a bump.

findings.highlight: I have told you many times
findings.evidenceJa: あれほど言った
findings.governingReading: Saber told him so emphatically
findings.explanation: Intensity of the prior warning becomes unsupported repetition.

findings.highlight: Where were you for the extra two hours
findings.evidenceJa: 何処であぶらを売ってた
findings.governingReading: where he had been idling or wasting time for two hours
findings.explanation: Sakura’s accusatory idiom disappears into a neutral location question.

findings.highlight: I should be able to come up with an excuse
findings.evidenceJa: 少しは言い訳らしきモノも出来る
findings.governingReading: he might manage at least something resembling an excuse
findings.explanation: The English removes Shirou’s self-deprecating hedge around his prospective explanation.

findings.highlight: I agreed with your decision to go to school
findings.evidenceJa: 学校に向かうという貴方の意見に従いました
findings.governingReading: Saber followed Shirou’s position that he should go to school
findings.explanation: Compliance with her Master’s position becomes agreement with a settled decision.

findings.highlight: I cannot forgive you this time
findings.evidenceJa: 今回は見逃す訳にはいきません
findings.governingReading: she cannot let this instance pass
findings.explanation: A practical refusal to overlook dangerous conduct becomes moral unforgiveness.

findings.highlight: It seems you are healthy enough
findings.evidenceJa: それほど元気だというのなら結構です
findings.governingReading: if Shirou claims to be that energetic, then very well
findings.explanation: Saber’s conditional, sarcastic acceptance becomes her own health assessment.

findings.highlight: I shall train you until dinner
findings.evidenceJa: たっぷりと鍛えてさしあげましょう
findings.governingReading: she will graciously give him a thorough training until dinner
findings.explanation: The time survives, but the mock-politeness and threat of an ample beating disappear.

findings.highlight: Saber pushes Sakura aside and steps closer
findings.evidenceJa: ずい、と桜を押しのけて一歩踏み込んでくる
findings.governingReading: Saber thrusts Sakura aside and plants one advancing step
findings.explanation: The distinctive force and exact single-step approach are generalized.

findings.highlight: I heard how good Saber-san is from Fujimura-sensei
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーさんの腕前は聞いています
findings.governingReading: Sakura has heard about Saber’s skill
findings.explanation: mirror moon invents Taiga as the source of Sakura’s information.

findings.highlight: I’m sure you’ll enjoy it
findings.evidenceJa: ご満足いただけると思います
findings.governingReading: Sakura believes Senpai will surely be fully satisfied
findings.explanation: The pointedly polite threat of receiving enough training becomes straightforward enjoyment.

findings.highlight: Sakura pushes Saber aside and roars at me
findings.evidenceJa: さらにずい、とセイバーを押しのけて怒る桜
findings.governingReading: Sakura in turn forcefully pushes Saber aside and advances, angry
findings.explanation: The English invents a vocal roar and loses the second mirrored forward movement that shows the women taking turns confronting Shirou.

findings.highlight: I’ll only add fuel to the fire
findings.evidenceJa: 火に油ネコにコバン
findings.governingReading: oil on fire, coins before a cat: Shirou’s panicked collision of two proverbs
findings.explanation: mirror moon deletes the deliberately mangled cat-and-coins half of Shirou’s verbal panic.

findings.highlight: if I say the wrong thing
findings.evidenceJa: 下手に事情を説明したら
findings.governingReading: if he clumsily explains the circumstances
findings.explanation: A risky truthful explanation becomes saying something generically wrong.

findings.highlight: Saber might even go as far as breaking our contract
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーなんて本気で契約解除をしかねない
findings.governingReading: Saber might seriously cancel their contract
findings.explanation: The English removes Shirou’s fear that Saber would do it in earnest.

findings.highlight: I’m sorry
findings.evidenceJa: 反省、してる
findings.governingReading: he is reflecting on or repenting of what he did
findings.explanation: A statement of contrition becomes a direct apology.

findings.highlight: Rattle, rattle
findings.evidenceJa: ガチャガチャガチャ
findings.governingReading: rattle, rattle, rattle
findings.explanation: One beat is removed from the door’s comic refusal to let Shirou retreat.

findings.highlight: The two retreat together in unison
findings.evidenceJa: ずんずんと廊下を引き上げていく
findings.governingReading: the oddly synchronized pair stride forcefully away up the hallway
findings.explanation: mirror moon turns their determined march toward the dojo into a retreat.

findings.highlight: I don’t know what they’ll do
findings.evidenceJa: どんな反撃が待っているかわからない
findings.governingReading: he does not know what retaliation awaits him
findings.explanation: The anticipated counterattack is weakened into unspecified action.

findings.highlight: I guess I have to atone for my actions in the dojo
findings.evidenceJa: 二人の言う通り道場でしごかれるしかない
findings.governingReading: he has no choice but to submit to harsh drilling in the dojo as they ordered
findings.explanation: The concrete prospective punishment becomes abstract atonement, omitting that the training has not yet occurred.
